## Questions and answers
**What does MakeBiz do in the UAE?**
MakeBiz Technologies is an IT integrator: we implement AI agents that take over routine in sales, finance, procurement and hiring, and automate business on Bitrix24 for companies in Dubai and across the Emirates, including WhatsApp, accounting integrations, licenses and BI analytics.
**Are you an official Bitrix24 partner?**
Yes, MakeBiz Technologies is an official Bitrix24 partner in the UAE: we implement and support portals and help with cloud and on-premise Bitrix24 licenses.
**How much does Bitrix24 implementation cost?**
Standard Bitrix24 CRM setup starts from AED 10,000. Work beyond the standard is charged at AED 200 per hour, with a fixed estimate after a short survey. The Bitrix24 license is paid separately.
**How much do AI agents cost?**
One agent on your process starts from AED 5,000, maintenance is 10% of the implementation cost per month. A demo on your process is free.
**Can you connect WhatsApp to Bitrix24?**
Yes. Connecting WhatsApp or another messenger costs AED 500, the provider subscription is paid separately. Every message creates a deal and lands in the client card.
**Do you work only in Dubai?**
We work with companies across all Emirates, meetings in Dubai or by video call. We speak English and Russian, documents and invoices in dirhams.
**Where do we start?**
Leave a request. We run a free diagnostic, find where requests and time are lost, and propose the first step with price and timeline.

## Questions and answers
**How much does Bitrix24 implementation cost in the UAE?**
Standard Bitrix24 CRM setup starts from AED 10,000. Anything more complex (several departments, accounting integrations, data migration, custom development) is charged at AED 200 per hour with a fixed estimate after a short survey. The Bitrix24 license is paid separately.
**How fast can the CRM be launched?**
Basic launch from 14 days. Accounting integrations, telephony and non-standard processes take longer, we name the timeline after the survey.
**Is the license included?**
No, the Bitrix24 license is paid separately at the vendor price. Cloud starts from AED 180 a month billed annually, we help pick the plan for your headcount.
**Do you handle VAT and UAE specifics?**
Yes. We set up AED currency, 5% VAT on invoices and products, free zone and mainland company details, the Saturday-Sunday weekend, and work in English, Russian and Arabic where needed.
**Cloud or on-premise Bitrix24?**
We work with both. Cloud is faster to launch, on-premise goes on your server when data must stay with you or deep customization is needed.
**What happens after launch?**
We train the team and stay on support with hour packages: from 5 hours a month for AED 1,250.

Title: WhatsApp in Bitrix24 for businesses in the UAE | MakeBiz

Bitrix24 · messengers
# WhatsApp and messengers in Bitrix24
In the UAE clients write on WhatsApp, not email. We connect the company number to the CRM: every conversation in the client card, management sees who replied and how fast
MakeBiz Technologies connects WhatsApp to Bitrix24 through the official WhatsApp Business Platform, plus Telegram, social media and website chat: a new message creates a lead or deal, assigns an owner, and the history stays with the company. Connection AED 500.
## What happens without integration
### Clients on personal phones
Each manager chats from their own number. When an employee leaves, their clients and all agreements leave too
### No reply, and nobody knows
A message came on Friday evening, the manager saw it on Monday. Management learns when the client has already bought elsewhere
### History lives in the chat
Prices, discounts and deadlines were agreed on WhatsApp, and the CRM is empty. The next manager starts from scratch
## How we connect
### Official WhatsApp Business Platform
The company number connects to the Meta API via a connector in the Bitrix24 Contact Center. We pick the provider by message volume and price
### Open channels
Conversations are distributed among managers in turn, by language or by business line. Reply time is visible, a chat can be handed over
### A lead or deal from the first message
A new number creates a lead or deal with the WhatsApp source, a returning client lands in their card
### After-hours auto reply
Considering UAE weekends and holidays, in English, Russian and Arabic where needed
### Reply speed control
If a message has no reply in 15 minutes, a notification goes to the manager
### Channel report
How many chats, how many without reply and how many became deals
## WhatsApp rules to know in advance
### The 24-hour window
You can reply in free text within 24 hours after the client's last message. When the window closes, you can write first only with a template approved by Meta: a reminder, order status, an invoice
### Templates and broadcasts
Template messages are paid, the provider sets the price. Broadcasts only to people who opted in, otherwise complaints grow and the number gets limited
## What we do
Connecting a channel is not enough, it has to be built into sales
- 1
### Number and provider
We choose the company number and API provider and pass Meta verification
- 2
### Open channels
Queue, distribution, working hours and auto replies
- 3
### CRM and robots
Chats linked to leads and deals, reply time control
- 4
### Templates and launch
Templates submitted for approval, team trained, we stay on support
## Contract and guarantees
What you get besides the work itself
### Under contract
Contract with MakeBiz Technologies FZE LLC, invoices in dirhams, payment to a UAE company account. We can send the draft contract before the call
### Fixed estimate
Standard work at list price, complex work after a short survey: you see the scope and price before we start
### Access and data stay yours
Portal, server and accounts belong to your company. We work under a separate account and close access at the end
### One team
Implementation, support, integrations and AI agents by one team, no need to gather contractors
## Questions and answers
**Can WhatsApp be connected to Bitrix24?**
Yes. We connect the company number through the official WhatsApp Business Platform from Meta and a connector in the Bitrix24 Contact Center. Conversations land in the deal card, managers reply right from the CRM.
**How much does it cost?**
Connecting WhatsApp or another messenger costs AED 500. The provider subscription and paid template messages are separate, we calculate the costs before connecting.
**Which channels do you connect?**
WhatsApp, Telegram, social media messages, website live chat and email. All conversations in one Bitrix24 window.
**Why not via the web version QR code?**
That connection is unofficial, with broadcasts and complaints the sales number can be blocked. For the main number we use only the official API.
**Will the history stay if a manager leaves?**
Yes, the whole history stays in the client card in Bitrix24, not on a personal phone.

## Questions and answers
**Which accounting systems do you integrate with Bitrix24?**
In the UAE most often Zoho Books, QuickBooks and Odoo, some companies use 1C. We also connect bank statements, warehouse and internal services via API.
**What data is exchanged?**
Clients and companies, products and prices, VAT invoices, payments and stock. The scope and direction of the exchange are defined in the survey.
**How much does integration cost?**
Integrating Bitrix24 with an accounting system starts from AED 10,000. The exact price depends on the system and exchange scope, the estimate is fixed after the survey.
**Is 5% VAT handled?**
Yes. Tax rates, company TRNs and VAT invoices pass between systems consistently, so accounting does not fix documents by hand.
**What if the exchange breaks after an update?**
We take the integration on support: we monitor the exchange and fix it within the hour package.

## Questions and answers
**How much does Bitrix24 cost in the UAE?**
Vendor prices from bitrix24.ae as of October 23, 2026, billed annually: Basic AED 180 a month, Standard AED 364, Professional AED 731, Enterprise from AED 1,465. There is a free plan for 1-2 users. The on-premise Business edition is AED 13,184 a year.
**What currency are the prices in?**
The vendor publishes UAE prices in US dollars. We show them in dirhams at 3.6725 with the dollar price next to it, the exact amount is fixed in the invoice.
**How much does annual billing save?**
Annual billing makes the monthly price of a cloud plan about 30% lower than monthly billing.
**Which plan should we choose?**
A sales team of up to 5 people is fine on Basic. A company of up to 50 people: Standard. For process automation and end-to-end analytics: Professional. Branches and hundreds of employees: Enterprise or on-premise.
**Cloud or on-premise?**
Cloud is faster to launch and needs no server. On-premise is chosen when data must stay in-house, deep code customization is needed or there are many users. Details on the on-premise Bitrix24 page.
**Will you help with renewal and plan changes?**
Yes, we remind you about renewal in advance and help move to a higher or lower plan without losing data.

Bitrix24 · on your server
# On-premise Bitrix24: implementation on your server
Data stays with you, the system adapts to any process and connects to internal services. We install, migrate, customize and support
MakeBiz Technologies implements on-premise Bitrix24 on a company server in the UAE: we pick the edition and server, deploy the system, migrate data from the cloud or another CRM, customize it for your processes, integrate with accounting systems and take it on support. ## When you need on-premise
If two or more of these apply, the cloud will feel tight
### Data only in-house
Security policy requires keeping clients and documents in your perimeter or in the UAE
### Code customization
Custom modules, non-standard entities, logic that an app cannot do
### Many internal systems
Your own ERP, accounting, telephony and services that need deep exchange
### Hundreds of employees
With many users an on-premise license costs less than a subscription
### Branches and holdings
Free zone and mainland companies, different entities and permissions in one system
### Control over updates
You decide when to update the system
## Cloud or on-premise
### Cloud
- Launch in a day, no server needed
- Updates and backups by Bitrix24
- Customization via apps and webhooks
- Monthly or annual subscription
### On-premise
- Your server or data center, data in your perimeter
- Code access and customization of any depth
- Direct integrations with internal systems
- Annual license, cheaper with a large team

## Questions and answers
**How is on-premise Bitrix24 different from cloud?**
On-premise runs on your server or in your data center: data stays with you, you get code access, can customize deeply and connect internal services. Cloud runs on Bitrix24 servers, it is faster to launch, but customization is limited to apps.
**How much does on-premise Bitrix24 cost?**
License at bitrix24.ae prices as of October 23, 2026: Business for 50 users AED 13,184 a year ($3,590), with options for 100, 250 and 500 users. Enterprise from 1,000 users AED 91,776 ($24,990). Implementation is charged at AED 200 per hour, the estimate is fixed after a survey.
**What server is needed?**
Your own physical server, a cloud virtual machine or a data center in the UAE. We size the configuration for your users, deploy the environment and set up backups.
**Can a cloud portal be moved to on-premise?**
Yes. We migrate CRM, tasks, users and files, rebuild what does not move automatically and check the data before switching the team.
**Who will update and maintain it?**
We can take it on support: updates, backups, monitoring, security and improvements. Packages from AED 1,250 a month.

Title: HAVAL case: speech analytics for a dealer network | MakeBiz

Case · Automotive
# HAVAL: speech analytics for a dealer network
We analyze dealership sales calls across Russia: the system checks over 300,000 minutes of conversation a month against 40+ criteria, escalates to a senior manager when quality drops below 70%, and rolls everything up into BI dashboards.
Automotive Sales and B2B BI and analytics AI agents
Result 300,000+ call minutes a month
Client HAVAL, a global carmaker
Region Russia
What we built speech analytics, BI dashboards and AI agents
Before hundreds of thousands of call minutes went unchecked
After 40+ criteria on every call and escalation on risk
## The task
HAVAL has a dealership network across Russia and a huge flow of sales calls, over 300,000 minutes of conversation a month even on a sample. Checking that volume by hand is impossible, spot checks covered a fraction of a percent, and off the shelf tools could not cope with such volumes and 40+ communication criteria. Script deviations and lost sales went unnoticed.
## What we did
We built speech analytics as a fully custom solution: it processes calls across the whole network and scores every conversation against 40+ criteria based on a checklist and scripts, handling over 300,000 minutes a month. AI agents flag weak calls: if a conversation drops below 70%, it is automatically escalated to a senior manager so the sale is not lost. We connected BI dashboards with deep analytics on how calls influence sales and tracking of deals after a call, NPS and feedback collection, and we give management ready summaries. The speech analytics, the agents and the dashboards are all custom development. On top of that, agents book customers into the service center, remind about scheduled maintenance and upsells, and act as account managers.
## The result
Now HAVAL sees how the whole network talks to customers, at a scale beyond manual review or off the shelf tools. Weak calls are caught and escalated in time, script compliance is measurable, and the link between a call and a sale is visible in dashboards rather than guessed.
speech analytics + agents + BI: 40+ criteria , auto escalation below 70%, dashboards.

Title: Apartico case: property rental across Russia in one CRM | MakeBiz

Case · Real estate
# Apartico: property rental across Russia in one CRM
We brought rental of apartments, serviced apartments, dachas and houses into one system: over a thousand objects across the country, auto posting of listings to Avito, Cian and other portals, an AI agent that qualifies enquiries and helps with booking, and speech analytics that watches politeness and empathy on calls.
Real estate Services Bitrix24 and CRM AI agents BI and analytics
Result 1,000+ properties in one CRM
Client Apartico, property rental
Region Russia
What we built CRM, AI agent, portal integrations, speech analytics, BI
Before listings, portals and enquiries handled by hand and apart
After posting, enquiries, bookings and analytics in one CRM
## The task
Apartico rents out apartments, serviced apartments, dachas and houses across Russia, with over a thousand objects. Listings have to be posted and kept current on many portals at once, enquiries pour in from Avito, Cian and other sites, from messengers and by phone, and then they have to be qualified, taken into booking, confirmed and followed up for feedback. While all of this was done by hand and in different places, listings and enquiries got lost, managers drowned in routine, and there was no single picture of objects, bookings and service quality.
## What we did
We rolled out a CRM for property rental and tied it to the whole external loop. We set up automatic posting of listings to Avito, Cian and other portals and a reverse feed: every enquiry from portals, the website, messengers and telephony lands straight in the CRM linked to its object. First response and qualification were taken over by an AI agent: it replies instantly, clarifies dates, parameters and budget, suggests suitable objects and passes hot enquiries to a manager. Managers run everything in the CRM, and the agent helps at every step: booking, booking confirmation and feedback collection after check in. We connected BI dashboards so the team sees its metrics by object, portal, enquiry and booking. Separately we deployed speech analytics: it processes operator and client calls and scores how friendly, polite and empathetic the staff are, to keep service at a high level. The solution works the same for every object type and across all regions of the country.
## The result
Now the whole rental business lives in one CRM: listings are published to portals automatically, enquiries from every source are collected and qualified by the agent, bookings, confirmations and feedback are run in the system, and management sees the metrics by object and portal in dashboards. speech analytics shows how the team talks to clients and keeps politeness and empathy under control. The same process works for a city apartment and a house in the countryside, across the whole country.
CRM + auto posting to portals + AI agent + speech analytics and BI across all objects.

## Questions and answers
**Which VPS do we need for Bitrix24?**
Cloud Bitrix24 needs no server. For on-premise Bitrix24 with 50 users a server with 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM and an NVMe disk is usually enough, for hundreds of users more. We size the configuration for your users and load.
**Are there servers in the UAE?**
Yes, some providers on the list offer UAE locations, marked UAE in the card. If data must stay in the country, we start with them.
**Do you resell servers?**
No. You buy the server from the provider directly, on your own account, and pay them. We help you choose, deploy and configure the system and can take the server on support.
**How much does server setup cost?**
Work is AED 200 per hour or within a support package from AED 1,250 a month. We give an estimate in hours before we start.
**Why are the links affiliate links?**
MakeBiz may receive a reward from the provider, your price does not change. The list and order are the same as in our catalogue servercalc.com.

Title: Bitrix24 vs HubSpot for a UAE company | MakeBiz

CRM comparison · UAE
# Bitrix24 vs HubSpot
Both are good systems. The difference is the pricing model, what is included and how many extra tools you end up buying around the CRM
The main difference for a UAE company: Bitrix24 is priced per company (Standard for up to 50 users is AED 364 a month billed annually, bitrix24.ae price), while HubSpot Sales Hub is priced per seat (Professional from $90 per seat a month plus a required $1,500 onboarding, hubspot.com prices as of October 23, 2026). The bigger the team, the bigger the gap. MakeBiz Technologies implements Bitrix24, setup from AED 10,000.
## When to choose which
Honestly, each system has its strength
### Bitrix24 fits
A team of 10 or more, you need tasks, documents, telephony and chats in one system, a predictable company-wide price and an on-premise option
### HubSpot fits
Marketing and content come first, the sales team is small, you rely on English-language marketing integrations and per-seat pricing is not a concern
## Side by side
Vendor data as of October 23, 2026. Features depend on the plan
| Point | Bitrix24 | HubSpot Sales Hub
| Pricing model | per company, plan by number of users | per seat
| Example price | Standard up to 50 users: AED 364 a month billed annually | Professional: from $90 per seat a month
| Required onboarding | none | $1,500 (Professional), $3,500 (Enterprise)
| Tasks, documents, chats | in one system | focus on CRM and marketing
| On-premise version | yes, from AED 13,184 a year | no, cloud only
| WhatsApp | via connectors, our setup AED 500 | via integrations
Bitrix24: bitrix24.ae, HubSpot: hubspot.com/pricing/sales, checked October 23, 2026. USD/AED 3.6725
### We will calculate the total cost for your team
Tell us the number of users and the features you need, we compare both systems over three years in AED
Get the comparison
## Example for 25 sales reps
Illustrative figures from vendor price lists as of October 23, 2026. Rate 3.6725
Bitrix24 Standard covers up to 50 users: AED 364 a month billed annually, about AED 4,370 a year for the whole company. HubSpot Sales Hub Professional: from $90 per seat a month, for 25 seats that is from $2,250 a month, about AED 8,260, plus a one-time $1,500 onboarding. Our Bitrix24 setup starts at AED 10,000. We will run the exact comparison for your team on a call

- 3
### Migration and check
We migrate and reconcile counts and amounts

### Training

Many Dubai teams work in several languages. Training everyone together means half the room listens to a translation. We split groups by role and language and give a CRM working guide in English and Russian. Role-based access is covered in our news on who sees what in the CRM

What AI does inside Bitrix24, what agents add and what it costs

Bitrix24 helpdesk, November 6, 2026

Searchable text in the language of the call

The key points in the deal timeline

Empty fields are filled, filled ones only get a suggested change

The call is scored against your sales script

The next activity with a short call outcome

Chats in leads, deals, contacts and companies

## Limits, plan and data
Regular Bitrix24 plans have monthly AI limits, Vibe+ plans do not (Bitrix24 blog, August 17, 2026). CoPilot runs on third-party models such as OpenAI; if data must stay with you, we deploy agents on your server, including in the UAE. Plan prices: Bitrix24 licences

## Bitrix24 plan and REST API
apidocs.bitrix24.com, checked November 11, 2026
Ongoing REST API access in the cloud now comes with Vibe+ plans, not Essentials. Existing subscriptions may keep access for a transition period, and a 15-day Professional Vibe+ trial is available for testing. The cloud limit is 2 requests per second with a burst of up to 50, on Enterprise 5 and 250. On-premise, your server sets the load. So we check the plan before the estimate and for heavy exchanges consider on-premise Bitrix24 ; see our news on cloud or own server
## How we work
- 1
### Review
What to connect, which data, which direction
- 2
### Map and estimate
Objects, fields, events, hours and price in AED
- 3
### Build and test
Test data first, then live data
- 4
### Launch and support
Exchange documentation, then a support package

Page: https://makebiztechnologies.com/en/journal/whatsapp-business-api-vs-whatsapp-web
Title: WhatsApp Business API or WhatsApp Web in your CRM | MakeBiz

Journal · Messaging
# WhatsApp Business API or WhatsApp Web in your CRM
In the UAE customers message you on WhatsApp, so it is one of the first channels a company connects to its CRM. There are two ways to do it: the official WhatsApp platform or a WhatsApp Web connector. Here is how they differ.
For a UAE sales team the official WhatsApp Business Platform (API) is the safer choice: one number for the whole team, conversations inside the client record, templates and clear limits. A WhatsApp Web connector relies on third-party software, and the WhatsApp terms for the Business App prohibit apps that interact with the service without WhatsApp's written consent. MakeBiz Technologies connects the channel to Bitrix24 for AED 500, Meta message fees are separate.
MakeBiz Technologies · 10 November 2026 · 7 min read
## The two options are different by design
The official platform is a business channel: your company number is verified by Meta and connected to the CRM through a provider. WhatsApp Web in a CRM is a workaround: a program or browser extension reads chats from the app on a phone and copies them into the portal.
| Criterion | WhatsApp Business Platform (API) | WhatsApp Web in a CRM
| How it connects | Through a provider, number verified by Meta | Third-party software attached to the phone app
| WhatsApp terms | Official channel for businesses | Business App terms prohibit such apps without written consent
| Team | One number, chats routed between reps | Depends on one app session staying alive
| First message to a client | A template approved by Meta | Free text, outside platform rules
| Broadcasts | The limit grows with message quality | Bulk sends put the number at risk
| Cost | Provider subscription plus Meta message fees | Cheap at first, expensive if the number is lost
MakeBiz Technologies comparison based on WhatsApp and Meta documents, checked 10 November 2026.
## WhatsApp's own terms settle the question
The WhatsApp Terms for WhatsApp Business App (effective 23 September 2026, section 5 "Restrictions") say a company must not develop or use any applications that interact with the Business App services without WhatsApp's prior written consent, and must not scrape or extract data from them. The same terms describe the app as designed for small to medium businesses.
A WhatsApp Web connector is exactly that kind of third-party app. It works fine until it does not. If the terms are breached the account can be restricted, and with the number the company loses the channel its clients know it by. That is a sales risk, not a matter of taste.
## The 24-hour window and templates come with the API
According to Meta's pricing documentation , a message from a customer opens a 24-hour customer service window. Inside it your rep replies in free text, outside it you can only send a template. Templates are approved by Meta in advance: a meeting reminder, an order status, an invoice.
For a CRM this means response speed has a price. In Bitrix24 we set up response time control: if a message has no reply for 15 minutes, the manager is notified while the window is still open. How an agent can sort incoming leads is covered in our news piece on the AI agent in WhatsApp .
Templates fall into categories: marketing, utility and authentication, while ordinary replies inside the window count as service messages. The category sets the price of a message, so name templates in the CRM in a way that lets a rep see at a glance which one is promotional and which one is for handling an order.
### We connect WhatsApp to Bitrix24 the official way
Company number, open channels, a lead from the first message and response time control. Connection AED 500
Connect WhatsApp
## Broadcast limits grow with quality
Meta's messaging limits page defines the limit as the number of unique WhatsApp users a business can message outside a customer service window in a moving 24-hour period. A newly created business portfolio starts at 250. Completing one of the scaling paths raises it to 2,000.
After that the limit rises automatically if messages across all your numbers and templates are high quality and you use at least half of your current limit over 7 days. That is why blasting a list of people who never opted in hurts twice: complaints lower your quality rating, and the limit goes down with it.
## What each option costs
The official channel has three budget lines:
- connection and setup in Bitrix24: AED 500 one-off with us, covering the number, open channels, routing and deal fields
- the API provider subscription: at the provider's rates
- Meta message fees: they depend on the market and the message category, and since 1 October 2026 service messages above 1,000 a month per number are charged too, see our news on WhatsApp Business pricing in the UAE
WhatsApp Web looks free, but the bill arrives later: time spent reconnecting, chats that never reached the CRM and the risk of losing the number. The full scope is on the WhatsApp and messengers in Bitrix24 page, and all prices are on the pricing page .
To see your own number in advance, export last month's outgoing messages from the portal and split them into templates and live replies from reps. That is quicker than guessing from the rate card.
## How to move from WhatsApp Web to the API
- Decide which number becomes the company number and export the chats you need from the app
- Pick an API provider and complete Meta's business verification
- Set up open channels: queue, working hours with UAE weekends, auto-reply
- Link chats to leads and deals and add response time control
- Get 3 to 5 templates approved: first message, reminder, invoice, status
- Tell clients if the number changes and switch off the old connector
The longest waits are usually business verification and template approval. That is why the old connector is switched off only once the new channel is live and the team is used to it, so sales do not stop during the move.
## A worked example: an agency with 8 sales reps
A hypothetical Dubai agency runs WhatsApp Web in its CRM: every rep works from their own phone and some chats never reach the portal. After moving to the API the agency has one number, chats are routed in turn, and the manager sees each rep's response time. One-off cost: AED 500 for the channel plus a few hours on automation and templates at AED 200 an hour.
## Questions and answers
**Can I connect WhatsApp Web to Bitrix24?**
Such connectors exist, but the WhatsApp terms for the Business App prohibit apps that interact with the service without WhatsApp's written consent. For a company the official platform is the safer route.
**How much does the WhatsApp Business API cost in the UAE?**
Connecting it to Bitrix24 is AED 500 one-off with us. The provider subscription and Meta message fees come on top, and the fees depend on the market and the message category.
**What is the 24-hour window in WhatsApp?**
A customer message opens a 24-hour customer service window in which you can reply in free text. Outside it a business can only send templates approved by Meta.
**How many messages can I send through the WhatsApp API?**
A new business portfolio can message 250 unique users in 24 hours outside the service window. It can be raised to 2,000, and after that it grows with message quality.
**Can several sales reps work with one number?**
Yes. With the API the company number is connected to Bitrix24 open channels, and chats are routed between reps by queue, language or team.

Title: How to choose a Bitrix24 partner in the UAE: 8 checks | MakeBiz

Journal · Bitrix24
# How to choose a Bitrix24 partner in the UAE
You pick a partner for years, not weeks: they build your CRM, hold admin access to the portal and pick up the phone when something breaks. Here is what to check before you sign.
Check a Bitrix24 partner in the UAE on 8 points: a listing in the partner directory on bitrix24.ae, a contract with a UAE legal entity and invoices in dirhams, a written estimate with an hourly rate, access registered to your company, support after launch, the team's working language, real case studies and a training plan. For reference, a standard CRM setup at MakeBiz Technologies starts at AED 10,000 and extra work is AED 200 an hour.
MakeBiz Technologies · 10 November 2026 · 7 min read
## Eight checks before you sign
Most of these take one call and one email. If a partner is vague on two or three of them, stop before the deposit, not after it.
| What to check | How | Red flag
| Partner status | Listing in the bitrix24.ae directory | No link, or "we work through a partner we know"
| Legal entity and contract | Company name, licence, draft contract | No contract, or a contract with an individual
| Currency and invoices | AED invoice issued to your company | Payment to a personal card, "USD at today's rate"
| Estimate | List of work, hours, hourly rate | One lump sum with no breakdown
| Access | Who owns the portal and accounts | Portal registered to the contractor
| Support | Monthly hour package, response time | "Just message us" with no terms
| Case studies | Task, result, industry | Logos with no detail
| Training | Plan by role: sales rep, manager, admin | One general video call after launch
MakeBiz Technologies checklist, 10 November 2026. It works for any partner, us included.
## Partner status is checked in the vendor directory
Official Bitrix24 partners in the region are listed in the partner directory on bitrix24.ae . Ask the contractor for the link to their listing and open it yourself. Going through a partner also makes it easier to buy and renew licences and to switch plans without losing data.
Status alone does not guarantee a good setup, but it filters out resellers who pass your project on to someone else. MakeBiz Technologies is an official Bitrix24 partner in the UAE, and the scope of our work is on the Bitrix24 implementation page.
## Contract, invoices and estimate are fixed before work starts
For a UAE company it is simpler to work with a contractor that has a legal entity in the Emirates: a contract with a UAE company, invoices in dirhams, payment to a corporate account. Expenses are easier to book and disputes are easier to settle.
The estimate should show what the total is made of: standard setup, hourly custom work, integrations, training. Our standard CRM setup starts at AED 10,000, work beyond the standard is AED 200 an hour, connecting WhatsApp is AED 500 and an accounting integration starts at AED 10,000. All prices are on the pricing page . The Bitrix24 licence is paid separately, and we cover how to pick one in the guide on plans for 10, 25 or 50 users .
Ask separately how changes during the project are priced. The normal practice is that a new task is estimated in hours first, you approve the estimate in writing, and only then does the work start. If a partner is happy to make changes "as we go and settle up later", you will only learn the total at the end, when it is too late to argue about it.
### We will review your portal or the quote you got
Send us the estimate a contractor gave you or invite us to the portal: in a short call we tell you what is missing
Review my quote
## Access and data stay with your company
The portal, the WhatsApp number, telephony and integration accounts should all be registered to your company. The contractor works under a separate admin account that you can switch off in one click.
- the portal owner is your employee, not the contractor
- passwords to services stay with you, the contractor joins by invitation
- access is closed when the work ends, and the contract says so
If a partner offers to "register everything under us, it is faster", you risk losing your client history when you change contractors. The same questions apply to an AI vendor, and we listed them in the news piece on 7 questions to ask before signing .
## Support after launch matters more than a fast start
Teams ask for the most changes in the first two or three months: new fields, reports, automation rules, permissions. Ask up front how support works: an hour package, response time, who exactly answers. Our Bitrix24 support packages are AED 1,250, 2,300 and 4,200 a month for 5, 10 and 20 hours.
If your portal is already live and you are switching contractors, start with a review of the current setup. What that covers is on the Bitrix24 audit page.
## Case studies, language and training are checked on a call
Ask to see one project similar to yours: the task, what was set up, what changed. A good partner will also tell you what did not work the first time. Our projects with the task and the result are in our case studies .
Dubai teams often work in English and Russian at the same time, so check which language the partner trains in and writes guides in. Training works best by role: sales reps need the pipeline and tasks, managers need reports, admins need permissions and automation. How we run it is on the team training page.
## A worked example: two quotes for the same job
Take a hypothetical trading company in Dubai with 15 sales reps that gets two quotes. The first says "CRM setup for AED 4,000" with no scope. The second lists a standard setup at AED 10,000 plus 15 hours for the website integration and reports at AED 200, AED 13,000 in total, with stages and a launch date.
The first looks cheaper until the change requests start: each one is billed separately and there is no contract with a scope of work. Three months later the totals are close, but the company has neither an estimate nor a clear portal owner. Compare the scope and terms from the table above, not the bottom line.
If you already have both quotes, put them side by side against the eight checks and ask each contractor to fill the empty cells in writing. The choice usually becomes obvious, and price stops being the only argument.
## Questions and answers
**How do I check that a company is an official Bitrix24 partner?**
Look it up in the partner directory on bitrix24.ae. Ask the contractor for the link to their listing and open it yourself.
**How much does a Bitrix24 implementation cost in the UAE?**
At MakeBiz Technologies a standard CRM setup starts at AED 10,000 and work beyond the standard is AED 200 an hour. The Bitrix24 licence is separate: cloud plans start at AED 180 a month billed annually.
**Can I switch partners if my portal is already live?**
Yes. The portal and the data belong to your company, so the new partner joins by invitation and the old one loses access. Start with a review of the current setup.
**Who should the Bitrix24 portal be registered to?**
To your company and one of your employees. The contractor works under a separate account that you can switch off.
**What should the contract with a partner include?**
The scope of work and hourly rate, stage deadlines, support terms, who owns the access and how it is closed when the work ends.

Title: Which Bitrix24 plan for 10, 25 or 50 users in the UAE | MakeBiz

Journal · Licences
# Which Bitrix24 plan for 10, 25 or 50 users
Cloud Bitrix24 is not priced per user but per portal, with a user cap. So for 10, 25 and 50 people the answer is often the same plan, and the real question is which features you need.
For a team of 10, 25 or 50 people in the UAE, Standard usually fits: AED 364 a month billed annually for the whole portal of up to 50 users, or AED 4,368 a year. Basic at AED 180 covers only 5 people, and Professional at AED 731 a month (up to 100 users) is worth it when you need sales automation, call tracking and analytics tools. Prices from bitrix24.ae in US dollars, converted at AED 3.6725, checked on 10 November 2026.
MakeBiz Technologies · 10 November 2026 · 6 min read
## You pay for the portal, not for each person
A cloud Bitrix24 plan has a fixed price and a user cap: Basic 5, Standard 50, Professional 100, Enterprise 250 and up. A team of 10 pays the same for Standard as a team of 50, so the cost per person drops as you grow. The Free plan covers 1 to 2 users and is only good for a first look at the system.
| Team | Plan | Per month, billed annually | Per year | Per person per month
| 10 people | Standard | AED 364 ($99) | AED 4,368 | about AED 36
| 25 people | Standard | AED 364 ($99) | AED 4,368 | about AED 15
| 50 people | Standard | AED 364 ($99) | AED 4,368 | about AED 7
| 50 people with sales automation | Professional | AED 731 ($199) | AED 8,772 | about AED 15
| 51 to 100 people | Professional | AED 731 ($199) | AED 8,772 | from AED 7
Vendor prices from bitrix24.ae in US dollars as of 10 November 2026, converted at AED 3.6725, before promotions. Yearly total = monthly price × 12. All plans are on the Bitrix24 licences and prices page.
## Basic only fits a very small team
Basic is AED 180 a month billed annually and includes sales pipelines, recurring deals, online payments, and email, telephony and WhatsApp integration. But the cap is 5 users, so a sixth person will not fit. For a team of 10, Basic is off the table even if the features are enough.
It makes sense when the CRM is for the owner and two or three reps and the team will not grow within a year. If growth is planned, price Standard from the start: moving up a plan keeps your data, but permissions and automation for the bigger team still need a review.
## Standard covers most teams up to 50 people
On bitrix24.ae, Standard adds to Basic unlimited leads, invoices and estimates, a CRM form designer, e-signature, WhatsApp marketing, task KPIs, unlimited projects and 100 GB of storage. For a sales team that keeps clients, deals, chats and invoices in one place, that is usually enough.
The threshold is simple: Standard tops out at 50 users. If headcount reaches 55 in six months you will have to move to Professional, so plan the licence a year ahead, not around today's team.
Count everyone who will log in to the portal: not just sales reps but managers, accounts, the warehouse and assistants. A common mistake is to size the plan by the sales team and then find that the whole company wants tasks and chats.
### We will pick the right plan for your team
Tell us how many people will use the portal and which processes you need: we send a plan recommendation and an AED setup estimate
Pick my plan
## Professional is about automation, not headcount
Professional is AED 731 a month billed annually and holds up to 100 users. This is where the plan list first shows sales automation, call tracking, email marketing, ad automation, booking, analytics and reporting tools, task time tracking, task automation, RPA, HR tools and 1 TB of storage.
A team of 25 needs Professional when the process runs on automated scenarios: deals move through stages on their own, calls are tied to ad sources, the manager reads funnel reports. Which of your scenarios work on Standard is something we test on a demo portal before you buy, not after.
Enterprise starts at 250 users and AED 1,465 a month billed annually. Its list adds unlimited branch accounts, central administration, multi-level permissions, Active Directory integration and login history. For a team of up to 100 it is usually more than you need.
## Annual billing saves about a third
Billed monthly, Standard is AED 529 ($144) and Professional AED 1,061 ($289). Billed annually, Standard comes to AED 4,368 a year against AED 6,348 monthly, a difference of AED 1,980 or about 31%. Once a team has decided on Bitrix24, paying for the year is almost always the better deal.
The vendor price page also lists Vibe+ versions of the plans with extended AI features and REST API access, priced higher than the regular ones. Whether you need them depends on your tasks: a standard sales CRM usually does not.
## The licence is not the whole cost of a CRM
The plan is paid to the vendor, while setting the portal up around your process is the partner's job. At MakeBiz Technologies a standard CRM setup starts at AED 10,000, work beyond the standard is AED 200 an hour and connecting WhatsApp is AED 500. How to assess a contractor is in our guide on choosing a Bitrix24 partner in the UAE , and if you need your own server instead of the cloud, see on-premise Bitrix24 .
## A worked example: a company grows from 12 to 60 people
A hypothetical distributor in Sharjah starts with 12 users on Standard: AED 4,368 a year for the licence. A year later it has 60 people, the Standard cap is exceeded, and it moves to Professional at AED 8,772 a year. Data and settings carry over when you move up a plan, and with the higher cap come sales automation and reports the funnel can be rebuilt around.
## Questions and answers
**Which Bitrix24 plan should I choose for 10 users?**
Standard, because Basic holds only 5 people. Standard costs AED 364 a month billed annually for the whole portal of up to 50 users.
**How much is Bitrix24 for 50 users in the UAE?**
Standard for 50 users is AED 364 a month billed annually, about AED 4,368 a year. If you need sales automation, Professional is AED 731 a month.
**Is Bitrix24 priced per user?**
No. A cloud plan is priced for the whole portal and includes a user cap: Basic 5, Standard 50, Professional 100, Enterprise 250 and up.
**What happens if we have more than 50 people?**
Standard tops out at 50 users, after that you need Professional for up to 100 or Enterprise from 250. Your data carries over when you move up a plan.
**Can I buy a Bitrix24 licence through a partner in the UAE?**
Yes. As an official partner, MakeBiz Technologies helps you choose, buy and renew a licence, including together with a CRM setup.
